item.title: Cache Tech Community - Hands-On ML Workshop - April 2026
item.description: Join us on Saturday, April 25th, 2026, from 1:30 PM to 3:30 PM at Bridgerland Technical College for a hands-on, code-along workshop on building binary classifier models using the Kaggle diabetes dataset. Each participant gets their own cloud-based VS Code instance with everything pre-loaded and ready to go.
